specs_json.batteries: dual TB65 hot-swappable, up to 400 cycles

notes: Workhorse enterprise platform (successor to M300 RTK) for utility inspection, public safety, surveying. Hot-swap dual batteries, 6-directional sensing + CSM radar option, night-vision FPV.

failure_modes.name: TB65 battery cycle-life degradation
failure_modes.mitigation: track cycles in DJI Pilot 2, retire near 400 cycles, store at ~50% charge

failure_modes.name: Gimbal/payload connector wear from frequent swaps
failure_modes.mitigation: inspect and clean connector pins, avoid hot-swapping payloads with power on

failure_modes.name: O3 transmission dropout in RF-dense urban areas
failure_modes.mitigation: pre-plan RTH altitude, use dual operator/4G dongle where legal, survey RF environment

failure_modes.name: IMU/compass interference near steel structures
failure_modes.mitigation: calibrate away from rebar/vehicles, rely on RTK heading, maintain standoff from transmission towers

failure_modes.name: Motor bearing wear in dusty/wet ops despite IP55
failure_modes.mitigation: post-flight cleaning, scheduled motor replacement per DJI maintenance program tiers

failure_modes.name: Ice accretion on props in cold-humid inspections
failure_modes.mitigation: avoid visible moisture below 0°C, monitor for prop icing warnings, land immediately on symptoms
